message: "users"."email" is set to NOT NULL, which scans the whole "users" table while blocking reads and writes.
why: SET NOT NULL holds an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and checks every row, unless a validated CHECK constraint already proves the column has no NULLs.
safeAlternative: PostgreSQL 18: add the constraint without checking rows, then validate it in a separate migration: ALTER TABLE "users" ADD CONSTRAINT <name> NOT NULL "email" NOT VALID, then ALTER TABLE "users" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT <name>. VALIDATE does not block writes.
